subject: Too many requests from our sync

messages.name: Genco Pura Olive Oil admin
messages.body: We keep hitting IP-4290. Can you raise our rate limit?

messages.name: Priya (Support)
messages.body: IP-4290 means the per-minute rate limit was reached. Your plan allows 1,000 requests per minute. Wait for the number of seconds in the Retry-After header, then retry. If you run many requests in parallel, also watch for IP-4291, which is the separate limit of 10 requests in flight.
